answer: Bindings are kept in lotus, verified in pigment, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 4 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the falcon check. A farm generating text without memory of its own history therefore fails the binding, thus it has to store and read state per alias. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 4 times over for the same share of the pool. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
